Name: Squid Kid
Description: Calvin attended the Young Minds Science Expo, Sponsored by Stark-Tech, which was intended to introduce the next brilliant minds in science to the corporate world. Calvin brought his carbonadium synthesizer and was set up in the booth next to Moon Girl, who was preaching against "planned obsolescence." Calvin tried to make friends with her, but he had ulterior motives. He set his squid-themed harnesses to snatch up the other child geniuses for AIM, announcing himself as "Squid Kid." He was foiled by Moon Girl. During his escape, he offered Luna the chance to join him at AIM, but she refused.
